en: A multi‑view illustrated postcard with old‑style artwork. The main image at the top shows the Pyramids of Giza with camels and people in desert clothing. At the left is a robed figure standing on a crescent moon, holding a large bell. At the bottom left there is a city square with a statue/monument, a large building behind it flying a flag, and people walking around. Decorative text in the center reads "Souvenir d'Egypte". There is cursive handwriting in French over part of the card.
